notes: This bounded contract covers the regional extension of Umbra's declaration-management relevance planner. Active regional object-attribute and interaction subscriptions at a matching class establish the same Start/Stop Registration and Turn Interactions On/Off transitions as active ordinary subscriptions; passive regional pairs remain retained without establishing relevance. Region overlap and callback delivery remain DDM concerns, while the advisory callback still uses the official four FederateAmbassador methods and the per-federate advisory switches. This is development-profile source/test traceability only; it does not claim complete regional DDM, MOM, transport, package, protected-review, validation, or conformance evidence.
